name: jep_csts_v1_ratings_only_condition_last_retrain
original_prompt:
Instruct: Represent the passage for semantic similarity with respect to this condition: {condition}
Query: {passage}
ablation_prompt:
Query: {passage}
Instruct: Represent the passage for semantic similarity with respect to this condition: {condition}
training_semantics: ratings-only throughout; first-phase 5885 matched subset rows, then full 6051 ratings rows; zero evidence/proposition generation gradients

training.loss: squared error of cosines against normalized ratings

evaluation: validation-only checkpoint selection; test held out until native training stages complete
rationale: Decoder causal attention means moving the condition behind the passage changes what earlier token states can attend to; final attended EOD remains after both.
